reasons.image:
spirent/vstc/Makefile via the standard IMG_REPOSITORY rule (VENDOR=Spirent,
NAME=vstc -> "spirent_vstc"). Version "5.55.3216" is the vrnetlab README's
own worked topology example.
reasons.min_ram_mb:
No explicit "System requirements" section in the vrnetlab README for this
kind - it is a real traffic-generation/test appliance (Spirent Virtual Test
Center), same functional category as netplex's existing native
"test-traffic-ostinato"/"test-traffic-trex" taxonomy entries; sized like
those (2 vCPU / 4GB is the documented floor for the *other* vrnetlab test
tool README that DOES state one, ipinfusion/ocnos, used here as the nearest
comparable-class floor rather than an invented number). Default credentials
per README: admin / spt_admin. eth0 reserved for vrnetlab mgmt (generic
rule), data ports eth1+ used for actual test-generated traffic.
reasons.boot_timeout_sec:
README: "wait for the 'Startup Completed' message... then rebooted to fully
apply the configuration" - a two-phase boot, budget generously.

settings.description: Spirent vSTC (Virtual Test Center) via vrnetlab - a real traffic-generation/test appliance, not a router/switch. No native netplex profile of any kind exists.
